RECOMMENDED LAYOUT FOR TASK 1 ANSWERS
Write an introduction paraphrasing the information provided. If possible, change the
structure from a noun phrase to a noun clause (change the chart gives information
about the number of to the chart shows how many [...J
Write a clear overview of the main trends, differences, and stages. If there are trends
and differences (ie if there are changes cwer time), give some information about both. If
there are only differences, as in questions with no time scale, provide differences of
more than one type.

introduction or at the end, as it's the first thing the examiner looks for.
Separate your paragraphs with blank lines. It looks better and there can be no doubt
that it is a new paragraph.

signposting phrases to show your organisation to the examiner. Eg Looking first at the
most popular reasons, {...l
It's not necessary to write a conclusion, because you've already given the information in
an overview.
